build_pycolmap_reconstruction_from_track: build a PyCOLMAP reconstruction from batched NumPy arrays with tracks and reprojection error filtering
convert_pycolmap_reconstruction_to_numpy: convert a PyCOLMAP reconstruction object back to batched NumPy arrays for extrinsics, intrinsics, and points3D
build_pycolmap_reconstruction_without_tr: build a PyCOLMAP reconstruction from 3D points and 2D projections without using track data
build_pycolmap_camera_intrinsics: build PyCOLMAP camera intrinsic parameters from NumPy arrays for PINHOLE or SIMPLE_PINHOLE camera models
filter_tracks_by_reprojection_error: filter tracks by reprojection error threshold and minimum inlier count per frame before reconstruction
